topics.title: Basic Farm Tools - Meaning of Simple Farm Tools Primary 2 (Basic 2) - Agriculture
topics.content:
AGRICULTURE
PREVOCATIONAL STUDIES
FIRST TERM
WEEK 1
PRIMARY 2
THEME - PROCESSES OF AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS
PREVIOUS LESSON - Meaning of Agriculture | Who is a Farmer? Primary 1 (Basic 1) - Agriculture
- Agriculture Plan Lesson Notes Primary 2 (Basic 2)
TOPIC - BASIC FARM TOOLS
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. Identification of Simple Farm Tools
3. Meaning of Simple Farm Tools
4. Lesson Evaluation and Weekly Assessment (Test)
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most of the pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. say the meaning of simple farm tools.
2. name some simple farm tools.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The pupils can identify hoe and cutlass.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of samples of simple farm tools such as cutlass, sickle, axe, hoe, shovel, spade, hand fork, garden trowel, pick axe, basket, head pan, wheel barrow, garden fork, rake and watering can.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTION
SIMPLE FARM TOOLS
1. Cutlass
2. Hoe
3. Rake
4. Watering can
5. Wheel barrow
6. Basket
7. Head pan
8. Hand fork
9. Garden fork
10. Axe
12. Pick axe
13. Shovel
14. Spade
LESSON 2 - MEANING OF BASIC FARM TOOLS
Simple farm tools are the simple tools used for farming.
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Displays simple farm tools used in the school farm and the locality.
3. Lets pupils identify the simple tools they can recognise.
Pupil’s Activities - Observe some simple farm tools.
4. Discuss the meaning of simple farm.
Pupil’s Activities - Say the simple of simple farm tools.
5. Summarizes the lesson on the board.
Pupil’s Activities - Copy as you are instructed.
CONCLUSION
To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
NEXT LESSON
Classification of Simple Farm Tools (Primary 2)
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask pupils to:
1. say the meaning of simple farm tools.
2. name 5 simple farm tools.
WORKBOOK
WEEKLY ASSESSMENT (TEST)
1. _________ are the simple tools used for farming.
A. Simple farm tools
B. Simple home
2. Simple farm tools are the simple tools used for _________.
A. Farming
B. School
3. Simple farm tools are the _________ used for farming.
A. School tools
B. Simple tools
4. Simple farm tools can also be used in the kitchen.
A. True
B. False
5. Simple farm tools are mainly used on the farm.
A. True
B. False

topics.title: Simple Farm Tools for Cutting Primary 2 (Basic 2) - Agriculture
topics.content:
AGRICULTURE
PREVOCATIONAL STUDIES
FIRST TERM
WEEK 4
PRIMARY 2
THEME - PROCESSES OF AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS
PREVIOUS LESSON - Classification of Simple Farm Tools (Primary 2)
TOPIC - BASIC FARM TOOLS
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. Meaning of Simple Farm Cutting Tools
3. Examples of Simple Farm Cutting Tools
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most of the pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. identify simple farm tools.
2. identify cutting tools among other tools.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The pupils can identify cutting tools like cutlass and knife.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of samples of simple farm tools such as cutlass, sickle, axe, hoe, shovel, spade, hand fork, garden trowel, pick axe, basket, head pan, wheel barrow, garden fork, rake and watering can.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
INTRODUCTION
Simple farm cutting tools are farm tools used for cutting.
SIMPLE FARM CUTTING TOOLS
1. Cutlass
2. Sickle
3. Axe
4. Knife
5. Hedge shear or flowering scissor, etc.
USES OF FARM CUTTING TOOLS
1. Cutlass
- Cutlass is used for cleaning grassland.
- Cutlass is used for cutting trees.
- Cutlass is used for planting.
- Cutlass is used for cutting plant stems.
- Cutlass is used for harvesting.
2. Knife
- Knife is used for cutting crops for planting. For example, yam.
- Knife is used for harvesting vegetables.
3. Axe
- Axe is used for cutting trees.
- Axe is used for slicing woods into pieces.
4. Hedge shear
- Hedge shear is used for shaping plant flowers.
5. Sickle
- Sickle is used for harvesting rice, vegetables, etc.
Note - Engage the pupils to identify and state the uses of some of the simple farm cutting tools. Show and tell them the used of those tools unable to state their uses. If available, demonstrate the uses of some of cutting tools.
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Displays sample of simple tools for cutting or chart showing different simple tools for cutting.
3. Lets pupils Identify each cutting tools.
Pupil’s Activities - Identify each of the simple tools for cutting.
3. Uses the sample or chart to discuss the meaning and uses of cutting tools.
Pupil’s Activities - Participate actively in the class discussion.
5. Summarizes the lesson on the board.
Pupil’s Activities - Copy as instructed.
CONCLUSION
- To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
- Next Lesson - Simple Farm Tools for Digging (Primary 2)
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask pupils to -
1. explain the meaning of simple farm tools for cutting.
2. Give 3 examples 3 of simple farm tools for cutting.
3. state one example of the simple farm tools for cutting mentioned in question 2.
WORKBOOK
WEEKLY ASSESSMENT
1. ___________________ are farm tools used for cutting.
A. Cutting tools
B. Digging tools
C. Carrying tools
2. ___________________ is used for clearing grassland.
A. Knife
B. Cutlass
C. Axe
3. ___________________ is used for cutting trees.
A. Knife
B. Cutlass
C. Axe
4. ___________________ is used for cutting crops like yam for planting.
A. Knife
B. Cutlass
C. Axe
5. ___________________ is used for planting and harvesting.
A. Knife
B. Cutlass
C. Axe
6. ___________________ is used for harvesting rice.
A. Hedge shear
B. Sickle
C. Cutlass
7. ___________________ is used for shaping flowers.
A. Hedge shear
B. Sickle
C. Cutlass
Mention 3 simple farm tools.
8. ___________________
9. ___________________
10. ___________________
